title: Reframing Video Inverse Tone Mapping as Blind Posterior Inference via Latent Luminance Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.15146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-dynamic-range (HDR) displays are now common, but most video content, such as archival footage, broadcast material, and the output of generative video models, exists only in standard dynamic range (SDR). The need is sharpest for generated video, which has no HDR master at all and is graded alongside live-action and visual-effects material finished in HDR. Converting SDR to HDR means undoing a tone-mapping operation that was never recorded, and clipping destroys the radiance wherever it acts, so HDR recovery is a blind inverse problem. Methods built on generative video priors fill clipped regions with plausible structure, but their reconstructions are systematically biased: in every public method we test, saturated content leans too bright or too dark, and the direction of the lean moves with the tone operator behind the input. translated_title: 通过潜在亮度监督将视频逆色调映射重构为盲后验推断问题
translated_abstract: 高动态范围（HDR）显示器如今已十分普及，但大多数视频内容，如档案影像、广播素材以及生成式视频模型的输出，仅以标准动态范围（SDR）形式存在。这一需求对于生成视频而言最为迫切，因为其完全没有HDR母版，且需与以HDR完成调色的实拍素材和视觉特效素材一起进行分级处理。将SDR转换为HDR意味着撤销一个从未被记录的色调映射操作，而剪切会破坏其作用之处的辐射亮度，因此HDR恢复是一个盲逆问题。基于生成式视频先验的方法能够用合理的结构填充被剪切的区域，但其重构结果存在系统性偏差：在我们测试的所有公开方法中，饱和内容要么偏亮要么偏暗，且偏向的方向随输入背后的色调算子而变化。我们将这一失败称为亮度误差，对其大小和方向符号进行测量，并将其作为研究的核心焦点（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文将SDR转HDR的视频逆色调映射重构为基于潜在亮度监督的盲后验推断问题，揭示并量化了现有生成式方法中饱和区域系统性偏亮或偏暗的“亮度误差”现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes video inverse tone mapping (SDR-to-HDR) as blind posterior inference via latent luminance supervision, revealing and quantifying a systematic "luminance error" in existing generative methods, where saturated content is biased toward being either too bright or too dark.
